limits: This is an additive tool-v1 maintenance adapter, not another extracted native subsystem, dedicated maintenance service or complete updater.
Candidate equals pinned upstream d4205609, so no real later-upstream integration took place.
Published composition ad2fc047 is not present in this local object repository; requested_composition_commit_unavailable and stale-lineage findings remain visible.
Historical validation returns 1167 unresolved findings; no semantic ownership, authenticity, dependency or compatibility closure is claimed.
No host update, migration, activation, deployment or rollback was performed. Host-absent bootstrap proves inspection only, not failed-installation/state restoration.
Cancellation tests mock between-call admission; actual active-Git cancellation and process-group cleanup under cancellation are not established.
Git command output caps are post-capture; 90s is a command-admission deadline, <=30s per Git call, not a streaming-memory bound or instantaneous cancellation guarantee.
Production code has no fetch/mutation operation. Runtime acceptance does not independently attest absence of network traffic or fingerprint every input-repository file/ref.
Runtime proof is manager-level and Linux-only. It does not establish engine-session integration, macOS/Windows behavior or UI behavior.
No new UI cycle is included in this projection. Previous source42 GUI evidence retains its own identity; a root supplement must record any later actual GUI check.

All referenced raw receipts/packages are VM-local unless separately published. Publishing this sanitized projection establishes external durability only for included bytes, not all hash-referenced artifacts.
